meta.siteDescription: SeeO is an all-in-one SEO analytics platform: keyword research, rank tracking, technical SEO audits, competitor analysis, content optimization, and backlink analysis.

hero.title: Track rankings. Audit technical SEO. Find the keywords that matter.

features.sectionSubtitle: Every step of the SEO workflow — from keyword research to content optimization — lives inside SeeO. Data flows between modules automatically, with no repeated imports and exports.

cards.title: Keyword Research
cards.desc: Expand a seed keyword into a full set of related terms, with search volume, difficulty, intent, and CPC to find long-tail opportunities that can drive traffic.

cards.title: Rank Tracking
cards.desc: Monitor your rankings by keyword, location, and device, and get alerted the moment positions move — no more manual daily checks.

cards.title: Technical SEO Audit
cards.desc: Crawl your site and surface 404s, redirect chains, duplicate titles, missing Alt text, and other technical issues — prioritized so you know what to fix first.

cards.title: Backlink Analysis
cards.desc: See who links to you, how anchor text is distributed, and which backlinks are growing or fading — find link sources worth pursuing.

cards.title: Competitor Analysis
cards.desc: Compare your keyword rankings side by side with competitors to see where you lag and where the opportunities are — stop going by gut feeling.

cards.title: Content Optimization
cards.desc: Enter a page and a target keyword to see which topics to cover, how long to write, and what to improve — benchmarked against the SERP top 10.

preview.sectionSubtitle: Core metrics from all your projects in one dashboard — rankings up or down, site health recovering, where traffic comes from — at a glance.

Click the upgrade button on the plan you want, choose Alipay or WeChat Pay, and your benefits take effect immediately after payment. Membership is a one-time 30-day purchase; when it expires, your account automatically returns to the Free plan.
Alipay and WeChat Pay, provided as aggregated payment services by YaoLi Pay.

faqs.q: What happens when my membership expires?
faqs.a: Your plan automatically returns to Free. Data you have created (projects, keywords, reports, etc.) is kept, but features and quotas follow the Free plan limits. You can purchase again at any time.
SerpApi is a third-party SERP data API billed per call. The Free plan includes 50 calls per month; related features pause until the next monthly refresh once exceeded. Upgrading raises your quota.
Production uses a Turso cloud database, with user authentication provided by Supabase Auth. Each user's data is isolated.
